question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **associate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about the association between Latin and the Roman Empire. Therefore, the correct option to fill in the blank is ""associate"", which means to connect or link something with something else.
 
• Meanings of the other options:
 
 
• 1)** delink** - to disconnect or separate something from something else
 
• 2) **remind** - to bring back to one's mind or memory
 
• 4) **imply** - to suggest or indicate something without explicitly stating it.
